name: @caisson/license-issue
description: Ed25519 offline-license ISSUER (P6, ADR-0108 / implements ADR-0010). The PRIVATE counterpart to @caisson/license-verify: holds the signing key behind a Signer port (default Ed25519Signer over a 32-byte env-hex seed; KMS is an un-wired seam) and mints tessera-format license tokens by signing exactly canonicalize(parse(claims)) — the byte-identical payload @caisson/license-verify re-derives. NEVER published, NEVER installable into a buyer repo; the signing code lives only with the issuer service.
